about: The place outcomes people can hear about: each is a kept outcome of the outcome web that another engine reads (the file that reads it is named), with the subject its story is about. A month's record names every one of these that moved; the press decides what to print. The views engine holds stances only on policy questions and budget lines, so none of these topics moves a view by itself: a heard story is a known fact, and what reads it (the electorate's town conditions) cites the story.
